description.zh:
是否删除应用分组中的任务。取值如下：

- **true**：删除。
- **false**：不删除。
description.en:
Specifies whether to delete the jobs in the application group. Valid values:

true: deletes the jobs in the application group.
false: does not delete the jobs in the application group.

description.zh: 应用ID，在控制台的**应用管理**页面中获取。
description.en: The ID of the application. You can obtain the ID of the application on the Application Management page in the SchedulerX console.

description.zh: 命名空间ID，在控制台的**命名空间**页面中获取。
description.en: The ID of the namespace. You can obtain the ID of the namespace on the Namespace page in the SchedulerX console.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 delete-app-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --delete-jobs true --region cn-hangzhou
